title_en: FORECAST — TIROS, GOES, METEOSAT & WEATHER FROM ORBIT
title_ru: ПРОГНОЗ — TIROS, GOES, «МЕТЕОСАТ» И ПОГОДА С ОРБИТЫ
description: An interactive field guide to weather satellites: TIROS-1's first cloud picture in 1960, Nimbus and the Soviet Meteor system, ATS-1's spin-scan camera and the first full-disk image, GOES and Meteosat, today's GOES-19, Meteosat Third Generation, Himawari and Fengyun; how often geostationary and polar orbiters look at each latitude, why a 2 km pixel grows to 6 km at 60° north, and how Planck's law turns a cloud top's infrared glow into its temperature and height.
og: From TIROS-1's 1960 cloud picture to GOES-19's 10-minute full disk: geostationary vs polar coverage, ABI pixel stretch computed on the real fixed grid, and brightness temperature to cloud-top height, interactive and checked against NOAA, EUMETSAT and ECMWF data.
brand: FORECAST — TECHNICAL FIELD GUIDE / ТЕХНИЧЕСКИЙ СПРАВОЧНИК
